title: PoLPEST — The Perpetuation of Life Framework
subtitle: A Unified Geo-Thermodynamic Architecture for Civilization

blocks.text: This chapter presents the poster “PoLPEST — The Perpetuation of Life Framework” in full. It is a single dense diagram; open it, then use the explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools beneath it to work through the ideas at your own pace.

blocks.explanation: This poster frames PoLPEST: the Perpetuation of Life (PoL) fused with the extended PEST framework. Value is defined not by financial capital or subjective preference but thermodynamically — the degree to which any domain, discipline, artifact, or action increases the probability, duration, and quality of life's continuation. Part 1 casts every human enterprise (medicine, commerce, law) as a sub-routine fighting entropy to hold the Non-Equilibrium Steady State of living systems. Part 2 adds Proximity of Type and the Vatsalya imperative (protective parental compassion) as a weighting on the value function. Part 3 maps five PoLPEST dimensions — political/legal, economic/industrial, social/cultural, technological, biological/ethical — onto their contribution to PoL.
blocks.tts: PoLPEST: the Perpetuation of Life framework. A geo-thermodynamic architecture where value equals a system's contribution to the probability, duration, and quality of life's continuation.
